ussc_5k3_not_separate_pre2006.description: §5K3.1 early-disposition departures were not published separately by district before FY2006 (folded into 'government initiated departure' FY2003-FY2005; program began April 2003).

ussc_before_fy1995.description: No USSC district statistics before FY1995 in this atlas: the USSC posts district Statistical Information Packets from FY1995 and Individual Offender datafiles from FY2002 only.
ussc_before_fy1995.reason: Not published on ussc.gov (older datafiles are distributed elsewhere, e.g. ICPSR, outside this project's allowed sources).

ussc_child_pornography_pre2010.description: Child pornography was not a separate primary-offense category before FY2010 (USSC grouped it in 'Pornography/Prostitution', OFFTYPE2 code 28).

ussc_four_category_not_published_fy2018_.description: From FY2018 the USSC reports sentences relative to the range as departures vs variances (SENTRNGE) and no longer publishes the four-way grouping. The FY2006-FY2017 ids are not continued; the same grouping rebuilt from the SENTRNGE components (published FY2018+; USSC supplemental files FY2014-FY2017) is provided under *_2018scheme ids, marked derived. In the FY2014-FY2017 overlap the two are identical for every district.

ussc_four_category_not_published_pre2006.description: Within/above/government-sponsored-below/non-government-sponsored-below grouping not published by the USSC before FY2006 (pre-Booker departure categories; FY2005 split into pre-/post-Booker periods). Above/govt/non-govt shares are omitted for these years; within-range and §5K1.1 are provided.

ussc_fraud_category_break_2018.description: 'Fraud' (statute-based, FY1995-FY2017) and 'Fraud/Theft/Embezzlement' (guideline-based, FY2018+) are different categories; each id covers only its own years.

ussc_fy1995_1999_packets_do_not_sum_to_n.description: FY1995-FY1999 district packet counts do not always add up to the national packet figures. With all 94 districts present: FY1999 ussc_cases_prison_term districts 45,436 vs national 45,379 (+57). In 29 other variable-years a shortfall remains where district-years are missing (packet not posted or failing a safety check); there it cannot be told apart from the missing districts' own counts, and the missing values are NOT filled from the residual. Each district value is as printed in its own packet; the national value is the packet's national column. Do not present FY1995-FY1999 district counts as summing to the nation. FY2000-FY2001 reconcile exactly; FY2002+ come from one datafile and add up exactly. Full table: data/processed/ussc/packet_reconciliation.csv.
ussc_fy1995_1999_packets_do_not_sum_to_n.reason: separately printed USSC district packets vs their national columns (source inconsistency where all districts are present; not a parse error: the statistics audit's independent re-read reproduces every district value)

ussc_fy1995_2001_datafile_only_measures.description: FY1995-FY2001 come from published packets, which do not print the inputs for these measures (fine-only counts; probation-as-zero sentence lengths; §5K3.1; four-way range grouping; child pornography).
ussc_fy1995_2001_datafile_only_measures.reason: Individual Offender datafiles for FY1995-FY2001 are not posted on ussc.gov.
